correctness.rationale: Use the original synchronous nearest-to-own-opinion weighted-median convention: when leaves a<b, hub selects M=clip(x,[a,b]), not nearest endpoint. With d=(b−a)/2>0, m=(a+b)/2, z=(x−m)/d, the gap satisfies d_next=(1−s)d. If |z|<=1 the interior projection leaves x fixed and interior stays invariant. Outside, z_next=((1−2s)z+s sgn z)/(1−s); for s>1/2 put lambda=(2s−1)/(1−s), B=s/(1−s), so successive exterior side changes give R_next=lambda R−B. When s<=2/3, lambda<=1 and switching cannot continue indefinitely; when s>2/3, R0>B/(lambda−1)=s/(3s−2) generates strict unbounded normalized alternating exterior region. The aggregate dynamics contracts enough for consensus at every s in (0,1); on alternating orbits x_next+m_next=x+m+s sigma d, so summing gives c=(x0+m0)/2+s sigma0 d0/[2(2−s)]. New exact Fraction calculation confirms s=3/4 witness z path 4,−5,7,−11,19,−35, c=73/100. The infinite result follows by induction, not the finite prefix.
